message.content:
Here are some top-rated sushi spots in Los Angeles that consistently receive rave reviews:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Highlights |
|------------|--------------|------------|
| **Sushi Gen** | Little Tokyo | Classic omakase, fresh fish, intimate setting |
| **Nobu Malibu** | Malibu (just outside LA) | Celebrity‑famous, high‑end fusion, ocean view |
| **KazuNori** | Downtown / West Hollywood | Affordable, creative rolls, great for lunch |
| **Matsuhisa** | Beverly Hills | Chef Nobu’s flagship, upscale omakase experience |
| **Sushi Park** | Koreatown | Hidden gem, excellent nigiri, friendly staff |

If you’re looking for an unforgettable omakase experience, **Sushi Gen** or **Matsuhisa** are often cited as the best in town. For a more casual yet still high‑quality option, **KazuNori** offers great value. Enjoy your meal!
